title: RideLink Escorts, Age Rule and Pharmacy Stops by Level
content:
The Member Handbook schedule for Non-Emergency Medical Transportation states, for every RideLink level of service, how many escorts or attendants ride free, the age below which a member must travel with an adult escort, and whether a pharmacy stop may be added to a return leg.

| Level | Escorts or attendants riding free (most) | Adult escort required for members younger than (completed years) | Pharmacy stop on the return leg | Longest pharmacy stop (minutes) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| RideLink Transit Pass | 0 | 18 | No | 0 |
| RideLink Mileage Reimbursement | 0 | 18 | No | 0 |
| RideLink Ambulatory Sedan | 1 | 18 | Yes | 15 |
| RideLink Door-to-Door Assist | 1 | 18 | Yes | 15 |
| RideLink Wheelchair Van | 1 | 18 | Yes | 15 |
| RideLink Stretcher Van | 1 | 18 | No | 0 |

## Questions the schedule answers

- **At what age may a member travel without an adult escort?** At 18 completed years, on every level; a member aged 17 is younger than 18.
- **How many escorts ride free on RideLink Stretcher Van?** One.
- **How long may a pharmacy stop last?** At most 15 minutes on RideLink Ambulatory Sedan, RideLink Door-to-Door Assist and RideLink Wheelchair Van; RideLink Transit Pass, RideLink Mileage Reimbursement and RideLink Stretcher Van list no pharmacy stop.
